method: filesystem mtimes of experiments/*/*/*/*/metrics.json + fields inside each file; no training run, no test data opened
key_discrepancies: BUDGET_LEDGER recorded 18 units; the runs created after 2026-10-21T12:00Z are 83 (order03 53 + levelb 12 + split8 9 + split9 9). The ledger undercounted by 65 runs.
external_baselines contains 40 metrics.json files with epochs_ran = 0, i.e. no trained model; they are not training units but were present in the tree.
Only 26 of the 83 recent runs reached 30 epochs; median epochs_ran = 26 (min 12). A '30-epoch unit' is therefore not a fixed cost: early stopping made most runs cheaper.

concurrency_evidence.measure: count of runs whose metrics.json mtime falls in the same 300 s bucket
concurrency_evidence.interpretation: completion clustering is consistent with concurrency above 3, but mtime is completion time, not start time; exact peak concurrency is NOT reconstructable from these artifacts

unknown_fields: dispatch reception time (no record in the repo) - so I cannot delimit 'since last dispatch' precisely; I use 2026-10-21T12:00Z as a stated proxy
per-run start time and wall-clock duration (not written by run_candidate.py)
code hash per run: no run in the tree has a provenance block, so code identity is UNKNOWN for all 143 runs
peak simultaneous processes (no process log retained)

provenance_state.note: a run_hyperparameters/provenance block was added to run_candidate.py during this session but no archived run predates-or-includes it, so no archived run can be tied to a code hash
